related_questions.question: Why was the Johnson and Johnson vaccine discontinued?

text_blocks.snippet: The Johnson & Johnson (Janssen) COVID-19 vaccine was discontinued in the U.S. due to a rare but serious blood clotting disorder called thrombosis with thrombocytopenia syndrome (TTS). The risk, particularly for women aged 30-49, led to a pause in vaccination and ultimately, the discontinuation of the vaccine. Yale Medicine reports that as of May 17, 2023, 60 cases of TTS were reported, with nine deaths linked to the vaccine.
